official_policy_pages.page_updated_line: Updated: October 15, 2025 (Current Associates, see what's changed.)
verified_verbatim: Section 1: "The links must properly use the special \"tagged\" link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement (\"Special Links\")" — matches the register quote.

Section 5: "You must clearly and prominently state the following ... \"As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.\"" — the exact sentence the site carries in its disclosure strip and footer.

official_policy_pages.page_updated_line: Updated: April 14, 2026. (Current Associates, see what's changed.)
verified_verbatim: Participation Requirements §2(a): "Special Links enable accurate tracking, reporting, and accrual of commission income. Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you."

Participation Requirements §2(b) (tag): "you must include your Associates ID or \"tag\" (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site."

Participation Requirements §2(b) (price): "your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License." — the exact basis the site states in its price slots.

Participation Requirements §2(b) (claims): "You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices." with the 64 GB / 128 GB smartphone example.
Participation Requirements §2(b) (product lists): "When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link."

Participation Requirements §2(b) (sub-tags): "Under no circumstances may you associate any sub-tag, other ID or reporting provided in connection with the Associates Program with a specific end user of your Site".

Participation Requirements §6(t): "You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API ..."

Participation Requirements §6(v): "You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links) or the user agent of the application in which Program Content is displayed ..."
Participation Requirements §6(w): "You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site."
Participation Requirements §6(y): "Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality."
IP License §2(h): "you may store individual Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs) for an indefinite period until the termination of this License."

IP License §4 (Agent Terms): agents must identify themselves ("Agent/[agent name]" in the request user-agent string), must not conceal that access is from an agent, must not mimic human speed or keystroke patterns, must respond truthfully to human-verification prompts, and must not circumvent such measures. Registered as proposal SG-39.
official_policy_pages.flg_020_resolution: The three clauses FLG-020 could not find in Section 2 (ratings, URL-obscuring, shortener) are §6(t), §6(v) and §6(w) of the Participation Requirements on the restructured page. FLG-020 is resolved with these verbatim reads; citations.json (S02 entry) and policy-checks.json (C-04/C-05/C-06) cite the located clauses.
